title: Access Log Environment Summary
description: Environment, device, and place-context dimensions for aggregated access-log summary records (web, mobile, and thin-app requests). Reuses the standard Place Context, Device, and Environment datatypes so the field shapes match those emitted on interactive ExperienceEvents (for example by the Edge orchestration layer), giving analysts a consistent geo/device/environment model across interactive and summary datasets.

xdm:placeContext.title: Place context
xdm:placeContext.description: Geo location, IANA timezone, and IP-derived local time zone offset resolved for the aggregated requests.

xdm:device.title: Device
xdm:device.description: Device hardware characteristics (type, manufacturer, model, screen dimensions) resolved for the aggregated requests.

xdm:environment.title: Environment
xdm:environment.description: Network and software environment (ISP, carrier, domain, connection and proxy type, operating system, browser details) resolved for the aggregated requests.
